content: Issi gallas Nuhaama ba naaza machchiyo Uruto, «Ta nayee ne lo7o duus daana mala ta nees koyanaas bessennee?
Neni isttara gam7ida macca oosanchchati izas kiitettiza Boo7eezey nuna ashon laattiza dabbo. Haa siya, izi hach omars balen bangga bukkana.
Neni meecettada, shitto tiyettadanne lo7o may7o may7ada izi bukkiza bale ba; gido attiin baada Boo7eezey miidinne uyidi simmana gakkanaas iza ayfen beettofa.
Izi ichchizaso lo7eththa xeellada izas tohosora afala qaarada iza tohoson ichcha; hessafe guye ne hananayssa izi nees yootana» gadus.
Histtiin Uruta, «Ne gidayssa ubbaa ta ooththana» gadus.
Hessa gishshas Uruta duge baleza baada izi bolloteya izis yootidayssa ubbaa ooththadus.
Boo7eezey mi uyidi ufayettidaappe guye kaththa doore achchan ichchides; histtiin Uruta loddara izakko shiiqada iza afala tohosora qaarada tohoson ichchadus.
Giddi giddoth gidishin issi miishshi addeza daganththiin izi shirettishin issi maccassi iza tohosora ichchidaaro demmides.
Izikka izo, «Hanne ne oonee?» gi oychchiin iza, «Tani ne oosanchchayo Uruto; tana laattana bessiza mata dabboy nena gidida gishshas ne may7o macara tana mayza» gadus.
Boo7eezey zaaridi, «Ta nayee, GODAY nena anjjo! Hayssafe kase ne ooththoyssafe ha7i ne ooththoyssi aadhdhees. Dure gidiin woykko manqo yelaga attuma koshshu babeekka.
Ha7ikka ta nayee babbofa; neni oychchidayssa ubbaa ta nees ooththana; gaasoykka ta dere asay wuri neni lo7o haniza maccas gididayssa erees.
Tani laata dabbo gidikkoka nena laattanaas taappe matiza hara dabboy dees.
Ha7i hayssan aqa; bitanezi nena laattana koykko lo7o; izi nena laattana koyontta aggiko ta nees GODAAN caaqqays ta laata ekkana; gadey wonttana gakkanaas hayssan ichcha» gides.
Hessa gishshas Uruta gadey wonttana gakkanaas iza tohoson ichchadus; Boo7eezey, «Maccassi kaththa bale yidayssa oonikka eroppo» gida gishshas Uruta asi as shaakki erontta saaten koyrotta dendadus.
Boo7eezey izo, «Ne bollara may7ida may7oza haa bessa» gides. Iza bessiin nam7u tammu kilo gidiza bangga makki qolidi izo ba7issides. Izakka ba7ada katama badus.
Uruta ba bolloteyko biin Nuhaama izo, «Ta nayee ne bida yo7oy waanidee?» ga oychchiin, Uruta Boo7eezey izis ooththidayssa ubbaa yootadus;
Qasseka, « ‹Ne bolloteyko mela kushe booppa› giidi hayssa 20 kilo bangga taas immides» gadus.
Nuhaamakka izo, «Ta nayee, buro aazi hananaakko erettana gakkanaas naagaashsha; addezi yo7oza hach wursontta shempenna» gadus.
